content:
Apple has adjusted trade-in valuations for several iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch models, as well as some Android phones. Here are the latest amounts.

Apple today updated its trade-in valuation list, with most products seeing increased buyback prices, and some devices rising by nearly 30 percent. The company also added several Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, and OnePlus models to the list.

Below are Apple's trade-in valuations as of August 6, 2026. All amounts represent the 'maximum' value:

  • iPhone 16 Pro: $630 (previously $560)
  • iPhone 16 Plus: $485 (previously $465)
  • iPhone 16: $480 (previously $460)
